prompt: Edit image 1 to a moment about five seconds later in the same shot. The camera eases back about a quarter and slides to the right, keeping the dog at the left edge of the frame so the whole right half of the sheet is in view. Keep the table and its wood grain, the single white sheet of paper, the green grass zigzag, the dog on its blue checked blanket exactly as drawn in image 1, Maria's pink sleeves, her two small hands, the green crayon and the warm low light exactly as in image 1; only her hands, sleeves and the crayon are in frame, no face. Change the page like this: where the faint grey pencil arc was, to the right of the dog and standing on the green grass line, MACA is now drawn in crayon, exactly as MACA is drawn in image 2: standing upright on the grass line with the head at the top, a round white head with a teal visor band across its face and two small round blue eyes, square shoulders, a pink rectangular chest panel with a neat row of five little round chest lights in red, yellow, green, blue and purple, white arms and legs with orange joints, feet on the grass, about two and a half times as tall as the dog. Maria's right hand holds the green crayon and its tip rests on the green chest light, the last one to be coloured; the other four chest lights are already coloured. Image 2 is used only for how MACA is drawn: take nothing else from it, and the dog and the grass stay as image 1 shows them. MACA is never upside down and never lying on her side. The drawing is a child's crayon drawing on paper, crayon strokes and flat colour like the dog in image 1, with no grey pencil lines left on the page. Image 1 is the authority for render style, lens, lighting, room, furniture and colour: keep its finished 3D animated film look exactly, as if this were another frame of the same shot. Image 3 is the identity board. The identity board is a painted character sheet used only for identity (faces, hair, wardrobe colours); never copy its painted style, its plain background or its poses. Identity, from the identity board: Maria is a small girl with black bangs, a thin yellow headband, a side ponytail with a pink scrunchie, a pink overall outfit over a light-blue collared shirt and purple boots. The crayon boy has tousled ginger-blond hair and a green T-shirt with a small dinosaur. The braids girl has two dark braids and olive overalls over a cream shirt. The jersey boy has short brown hair and a white shirt with navy trim. MACA is a tall female robot with a white riveted helmet, a glowing blue face screen with two smiling eyes, a pink chest plate with a small dark inset screen and an orange hip plate. One instance of each character only. Output one 16:9 full-colour production frame, 1280x720, no text, no sketch lines.
